paragraphs: Yirmeyah Bira'ah said: Rav Yehudah said, chapter Pasin (25a), and chapter Ḥezkat HaBattim (53, end of side b). Rav Yehudah compelled Yirmeyah Bira'ah's son-in-law to give a bill of divorce, Gittin (34a).
